items.title: Tripadvisor Cuts Jobs, Outgoing CEO Says Experiences Overhaul Fell Short
items.summary: The Tripadvisor-Viator experiences business has long had a "Tripadvisor" brand problem. The consolidation of their teams didn't work, and both experiences revenue and profits fell in the third quarter.

items.title: EU’s Sustainable Tourism Plan Aims to Spread Visitors Out — With No Funding or Targets
items.summary: The EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy sits on top of existing tourism strategies released by the economic bloc’s Commission. But it still falls short of presenting measurable targets that would actually support its implementation.

items.title: Tripadvisor Announces CEO and CFO Exit 16 Months Into Starboard’s Activist Push
items.summary: You can expect the board to supercharge a sales process or to pursue other strategic alternatives as Goldberg exits.

items.title: Fuel Hedges Kept Emirates Profitable as Earnings Fell Two-Thirds
items.summary: Fuel hedges turned a likely loss into a profit for Emirates. The war’s full cost will show only once that cover runs out.

items.title: KLM to Cut Workforce by Nearly 15% in €1 Billion Cost-Saving Drive
items.summary: Despite improving profits, the Dutch airline says its future is far from guaranteed, with big changes needed to bring costs under control and restore competitiveness.

items.title: Minor Hotels Puts Its New Wellness Brand Inside a St. Regis It Owns
items.summary: Owning the building made this easy. Minor didn’t need anyone’s money to put its wellness brand inside a Marriott-run hotel. Getting an outside owner to pay for one, and agreeing with another brand on who keeps the client, will be harder.
